plan.frames: Poses are the TCP in the robot base frame (training model: body carrying joint_0; hardware: driver base frame). Translations are base-frame vectors. Rotations are base-frame rotation vectors applied on the left about the TCP origin (R_target = exp(r) @ R), the training apply_delta_pose convention.

relative.step_limit_note: per_axis clips each base-frame component of the translation and rotation-vector error to +-limit, as the training action does (clip(a,-1,1) * scale). euclidean limits the translation norm and rotation angle. The deployed policy uses per_axis.

plan.name: relative_tra_x+

units.time: s since command onset (monotonic host clock on hardware, simulated time in sim)
units.driver_tcp: m then angle-axis rad, driver base frame (driver's own FK)

training_controller.randomization: disabled (stiffness/damping, friction, size variants, pose noise, curriculum); only reset_scene_to_default is kept
training_controller.ik_timing: apply_actions every physics substep (DLS step from the current q); target written only at outer updates; sim.forward after each 25 substeps

onset.definition: simulated time 0 = first outer update; its target is set before the first physics substep

samples.note: sample i is the state after i physics substeps; tcp is training-model FK of arm_q

joint_targets.note: set by apply_actions at the start of each substep (time = substep start)
